atoms.name: Perceptron and linear separability
atoms.one_line: $\hat y=\operatorname{sign}(w^\top x+b)$; boundary is a hyperplane; AND, OR yes, XOR no.

atoms.name: Perceptron learning rule
atoms.one_line: On a mistake, $w\leftarrow w+yx$, $b\leftarrow b+y$; $yf(x)$ rises by $\|x\|^2+1$.

atoms.name: Counting parameters
atoms.one_line: Layer $n_{in}\to n_{out}$ has $n_{in}n_{out}$ weights plus $n_{out}$ biases.

atoms.name: Why hidden layers need non-linearity
atoms.one_line: Stacked linear layers collapse to one linear map; XOR needs a non-linear hidden layer.

atoms.name: Hidden units as half-planes
atoms.one_line: Each hidden threshold unit is a line; $k$ lines cut the plane into at most regions; universal approximation.

atoms.name: Convergence of the perceptron
atoms.one_line: Converges iff data are linearly separable; mistake bound $(R/\gamma)^2$.
